subject: Encord - chat
text:
Hi [NAME], 

Saw that you're comparing SuperAnnotate v Encord - are you actively evaluating annotation tools?

GoSign looks like a really cool and meaningful product. Given your focus on movement tracking and sign language recognition, I thought it made sense to reach out. Encord is built for computer vision and multimodal data (text, images, video, 3D) and also supports LLM eval. We work closely with teams doing fine-grained motion tracking in sports and human movement like Hudl, Veo, and Swingvision. 

I'd love to better understand your use cases and annotation requirements and see if Encord could be a good fit. 

I've dropped a placeholder for a quick chat this Friday at 9:30am PT- feel free to move it if another time works better.
